tactics:
induction xs with
  | nil => intro H; rfl
  | cons x xs ih => intro H; simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.pmap_append, List.pmap, ih]
intro H; apply List.ext_getElem <;> simp [List.getElem_pmap, List.getElem_reverse]
induction xs <;> simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.pmap_append, List.pmap, List.reverse_nil, List.reverse_append] at * <;> simp_all
